context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 complete. Parts catalogue CRUD, Sicon import, van stock, allocation (warehouse/van), intake enhancements (equipment_ids, equipment_serials, allocated_parts, required_skills, site_postcode), case PATCH, scheduler diary, assign, auto-assign all working. Scheduler UI has 36 unassigned cases with auto-assign buttons. Drag-drop not tested due to complexity of synthetic HTML5 drag events in headless browser - recommend manual testing or using POST /api/svc/scheduler/assign directly.

backend: POST /api/svc/parts - creates part with SKU auto-uppercased, returns existing on duplicate
GET /api/svc/parts/van/{engineer_id} - returns van stock joined with catalogue
POST /api/svc/parts/allocate - creates allocation on case, writes timeline event
POST /api/svc/intake/phone - accepts equipment_ids, equipment_serials, allocated_parts, required_skills, site_postcode
PUT /api/svc/cases/{id} - accepts equipment_ids, equipment_serials, required_skills, site_postcode patches
POST /api/svc/scheduler/assign - assigns engineer, sets scheduled_at, auto-transitions new→assigned
POST /api/svc/scheduler/auto-assign - returns rankings with breakdown (drive_minutes, skill_mismatch, van_match, sla_breach_risk, overtime_minutes)
frontend: Service Desk header has Scheduler link (data-testid='desk-scheduler-link')
Service Desk header has Engineer view link (data-testid='desk-engineer-view')
